content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: The common baseline qualification across almost all 59 posts is an Intermediate (Class 12) pass or an equivalent exam recognised by the Uttarakhand Board of School Education or the state government, along with a minimum Hindi typing speed of 4000 Key Depressions Per Hour (KDPH) on computer. A number of posts carry additional, post-specific requirements, for example: Computer Assistant, Junior Assistant-cum-Computer Operator, Computer Operator: knowledge of MS Office is also required, and for Computer Operator posts a minimum 6-month computer course is required. Pravar Sahayak/Senior Assistant (BRIDCUL): Intermediate with minimum typing speed of 25 WPM in Hindi and 30 WPM in English, well-versed in MS Office, minimum 5 years' experience in a Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector/reputed Ltd. company, and at least 3 years served in the relevant post/grade immediately below the post applied for. Junior Assistant (Transport Dept.): candidate must additionally be registered with an employment exchange located in Uttarakhand. Telephone Operator (Raj Bhavan Secretariat): preference given to candidates with experience operating an EPBX system. Junior Assistant (Uttarakhand Judicial & Legal Academy) and Store Keeper: a one-year diploma in computer operation is also required. Because the notification lists slightly different qualification wording for each of the 59 individual posts, candidates should confirm the exact requirement for their target post/department in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Age Limit
content_sections.text: The reckoning date for age calculation is 1 July 2026 . Age relaxation: 5 years for Uttarakhand SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates, 10 years for Uttarakhand PwBD (Divyang) candidates, 5 years for dependents of freedom fighters, and relaxation for Ex-Servicemen as per rules. State Andolankari (movement-recognised) candidates and their dependents get 10% horizontal reservation under a separate provision, not an age relaxation. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Exam Pattern & Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection involves two stages: a written objective-type competitive exam, followed by a qualifying typing test for candidates shortlisted on the written exam. The General Knowledge & General Studies portion (40 marks) covers General Intelligence Test & Reasoning, History, Geography, Political Science, Economics, National & International Current Affairs, and Fundamentals of Computers; General Hindi carries 20 marks; and General Knowledge of Uttarakhand carries 40 marks. Each wrong answer attracts a negative marking of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question. Minimum qualifying marks in the written exam are 45% for Unreserved/EWS/OBC candidates and 35% for SC/ST candidates; candidates scoring below this are treated as not qualified. After the written exam, a typing test is conducted as a qualifying stage (not counted toward merit marks) to verify the minimum typing speed required for the specific post. Final merit is prepared on marks obtained in the written exam only. In case two or more candidates score equal marks, seniority is decided first by age (older candidate ranked higher) and, if age is also equal, by alphabetical order of name.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: Vertical (category-wise) reservation: Horizontal (cross-cutting) reservation: EWS reservation is available only to candidates who do not already claim SC/ST/OBC reservation, and requires an EWS certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and the last date of application, based on 2025–26 income for financial year 2026–27. If a candidate claims reservation in a particular category but does not meet the unreserved-category merit cut-off, they will not be adjusted into the unreserved list unless declared eligible on that basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official UKSSSC website, www.sssc.uk.gov.in. Step 1 – Registration & Personal Details: register using your Aadhaar number (one Aadhaar can be used for only one registration) and your own mobile number and email ID. Step 2 – Educational & Other Details: fill in your educational qualification, category, and other required details. Step 3 – Upload Photo, Signature: upload a scanned recent colour passport-size photograph (150w × 200H px) and signature (150w × 100H px), plus a left thumb impression (150w × 100H px) in JPG/JPEG format. Step 4 – Make Payment: pay the application fee online via credit card/debit card/net banking/UPI. Step 5 – Print Application: after successful submission, print a copy of the final application form for your own records. Candidates should note down their registration number, since it is required for all further steps. After the last date, a one-time edit window (12.10.2026 to 14.10.2026) is provided to correct the application, but candidates cannot change their name, mother's/father's name, date of birth, or exam centre during this correction window.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: A candidate can submit only one online application per post; multiple applications for the same post will result in rejection of all such applications. Candidates must be registered at a Seva Yojan (employment) office in Uttarakhand by the last date of application, or hold a valid domicile/permanent resident certificate of Uttarakhand, or have passed their qualifying exam from an institution recognised in Uttarakhand - one of these is mandatory for candidates applying from outside the purview of the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission. A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer is mandatory for candidates already working in Central/State Government or a public sector undertaking, to be submitted before document verification. A male candidate with more than one living wife, or a female candidate who has married a man who already has a living wife, is not eligible for direct recruitment. Marks obtained in the written exam will not be shared with candidates before the completion of the selection process. Candidates are not permitted to carry mobile phones, cameras, calculators, pagers, or any electronic device inside the examination centre. Candidates who hold an Intermediate qualification can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and Junior Assistant Jobs opening up across India. Aspirants preparing for similar exams can also check the latest Uttarakhand Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to Dehradun can check Dehradun Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those with computer typing skills can also browse more Data Entry Operator Jobs and Group C Government Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission for 553 Group C posts - including Junior Assistant, Computer Assistant, Registration Clerk, and several other roles - across various Uttarakhand government departments, under Advertisement No. 80/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 553 posts in total, spread across 59 different post/department combinations. Three departments currently show zero vacancies and will be added later once reported.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 7 October 2026 is the last date for online registration and fee payment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UKSSSC Group C posts?
faq.answer: Intermediate (Class 12) or an equivalent exam, along with a minimum Hindi typing speed of 4000 KDPH for most posts. A few posts require additional qualifications such as MS Office knowledge, a computer diploma, or prior work experience - see the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Generally 18 to 42 years as on 1 July 2026; a few specific posts (such as Junior Assistant at the Tourism Development Board or the High Court, and Store Keeper) require a minimum age of 21 years. Category-wise age relaxation is available as detailed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹300 for Unreserved/OBC, ₹150 for SC/ST/EWS/PwBD candidates, and no fee for orphan candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only online at www.sssc.uk.gov.in from 8 September to 7 October 2026. See the "How to Apply" section above for the full step-by-step process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UKSSSC Group C posts?
faq.answer: A 100-mark, 2-hour written objective exam on General Hindi, General Knowledge, and General Studies, followed by a qualifying typing test. Final merit is based on the written exam marks only.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UKSSSC Group C posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level-02 (₹19,900–₹63,200) to Level-05 (₹29,200–₹92,300) depending on the post; most posts fall under Level-03 (₹21,700–₹69,100). See the Vacancy Details table above for the exact pay level of each post.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one UKSSSC post in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify a post-limit restriction in the sections reviewed here; however, a separate application and fee are required for each post applied for, and multiple applications for the same single post are not allowed.
